description: FloWave at the University of Edinburgh publishes controlled hydrodynamic tests on a restrained BlueROV2 underwater vehicle. Eight instrumented tethers measured loads while an underwater motion system captured six-degree-of-freedom response under currents, regular and irregular waves, and combined forcing. The 2020 DataShare release provides 178 downloadable TXT files containing raw measurements and processed directional forces, freely under CC BY 4.0. These laboratory data can calibrate station-keeping or fluid-force simulations for vehicles used in offshore infrastructure inspection. The tether arrangement, nearby cylindrical obstacles and one vehicle geometry mean transfer is limited to other maintenance vehicles or unrestrained operation. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
